traits.sexual_system.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Franseria (p. 150), now merged in Ambrosia; the traits given hold for Ambrosia as now drawn: plants monoecious, heads of one sex, staminate heads in terminal racemes with pistillate heads below them.

traits.pappus.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Franseria (p. 150), now merged in Ambrosia; the traits given hold for Ambrosia as now drawn: achenes enclosed in the hardened involucre, without pappus.

traits.capitulum_kind.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Franseria (p. 150), now merged in Ambrosia; the traits given hold for Ambrosia as now drawn: staminate heads many-flowered with funnel-shaped 5-toothed corollas and no rays; pistillate heads 1(-5)-flowered without corollas. Discoid is the nearest state.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Franseria (p. 150), now merged in Ambrosia; the traits given hold for Ambrosia as now drawn: leaves mostly alternate, toothed to three times pinnatifid.
